data.name: Couples Therapy (Cheaper Than the Real Thing)
data.headline: Couples therapy, but cheaper and with better glutes.
data.benefit: Couples therapy, but cheaper — and the only thing you'll fight about is who's holding the plank longer. Bring someone new: you get 10% off, they get 15% off, and you both get a 30-minute duo private.
data.rationale: Referrals convert 41.2% at Kwality, 22.6% at Bandra, 28.3% at Kenkere and 76.1% at pop-ups, versus 3.8–5.7% for website leads. The 2026 BOGO codes (70 uses, ₹3.1L given) went mostly to existing clients; this only pays out when a new person buys.
data.conditions: New person must be new to P57 (phone verified). Both must buy. ≈16% effective for the member.
data.kpi: Pairs formed; new buyers from referral (target +40% vs Feb-26).

data.name: Situationship → Relationship
data.headline: Stop situationship-ing your fitness. Two dates, then make it official.
data.benefit: Stop situationship-ing your fitness. Two dates, then make it official: 15% off your first month and a spot on the Stronger in 30 Rookie track. Finish it and we'll throw in an extra week. Commitment never looked this good.
data.rationale: Kenkere's VDAY50! code (38 uses, ₹2.6L given away at 50%) bought February volume at a huge cost. This replaces 50% with a structured path: a booked second visit lifts conversion from 10.8% to 43.9%; the challenge gives a reason to keep coming.
data.conditions: Standard 15% only; the +7 days are earned. Challenge is free with an active membership.
data.kpi: Second-visit rate (target 55%); trial → member (target 30%); Rookie finish rate.

data.name: Galentine's Gone Ghost
data.headline: Your bestie's been ghosting the gym too? Come back together.
data.benefit: Your bestie's been ghosting the gym too? Come back together. You get 15% off, she gets 2 classes on us — and if she joins, you both get matching grip socks and you get 7 bonus days.
data.rationale: Lapsed clients already know the product and bring friends who convert like referrals (22–76%). Pairing two hesitant people raises the odds both show up.
data.conditions: Friend must be new. Bonus only when the friend buys (≈20% effective for the returner).
data.kpi: Returners with a friend; friend → purchase (target 30%).

data.name: Proof of Work
data.headline: You did 30 in 30. Your renewal price should show it.
data.benefit: You did 30 classes in 30 days. Your renewal price should show it: 6 months at 20% off, or an annual at 22% off with an extra private. Receipts, not resolutions.
data.rationale: Renewers average 6.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 2.6–3.4 for lapsers; members using 75%+ of sessions renew 82–88% across studios. The best price only goes to proven attenders.
data.conditions: Price unlocked by verified attendance. 6M at 20% and annual at ≈24% effective sit inside the caps. Claim by 2027-03-10.
data.kpi: Finish rate; finisher renewal yield vs non-finishers; 3M+ share of renewal value (target 45%).

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up Situationship → Relationship in Momence (2027-02-01 to 2027-02-21): Mumbai: Newcomers 2-for-1 (₹1,943); take both classes within 10 days, buy 1 Month at the standard 15% (₹17,203) within 72 hours and join the Stronger in 30 Rookie track (16 classes) — finish it for +7 days. Kenkere: 50% intro (₹709) + class 2 free if booked at the desk, then the same. Pop-ups: paid trial (≈₹945) → 8-class pack at 15% (₹5,891) within 72 hours + Rookie track (8 classes).
